items.information: *English:* This competition will hold **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event**, and it will be held in multiple locations, across Latin America. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2023#24247-locations-lugares)! Locations may be added until the 25th of February 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) in Latin America. --- *Español:* Esta competencia tendrá **solo el evento 3x3x3 Menos Movimientos**, y se llevará a cabo en múltiples ubicaciones en América Latina. ¡Preste atención a la **fecha y zona horaria** de su [ubicación](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2023#24247-locations-lugares)! Se pueden agregar ubicaciones hasta el 25 de febrero a las 23:59 UTC, por lo que si aún no hay una ubicación cerca de usted, comuníquese con su [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local en América Latina. --- *Português:* Esta competição contará **apenas com a modalidade 3x3x3 Menos Movimentos** e será realizada em vários locais da América Latina. Preste atenção à **data e fuso horário** da sua [localidade](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2023#24247-locations-lugares)! Os locais podem ser adicionados até 25 de fevereiro às 23h59 UTC, portanto, se ainda não houver um local próximo a você, entre em contato com o [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local na América Latina.

items.information: # If you do not see a location near you, reach out to your local delegate to help them find a location! Tune into the first live streamed FMC competition to watch the best competitors from North America vie for the win! - This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. We will not be holding any other event. - This competition will take place at different venues across North America. Please reach out to local delegates to reach out to us about hosting a location. - Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLIVENorthAmerica2025#46204-locations) for more details. # Notice of Filming and Photography Competitors and spectators of the event may end up on the Livestream.
